name: For Loop (Per-Row Validation/Processing)
description: Iterates a dataset, running a nested action list (typically validatedataset) against each row. This is how grid/detail-line validation is implemented — see molecules/validation-grid-rows.json for the full composed pattern including row-level error flags and the errorRowCount summary check.

perform.description: Action list run once per row, with 'this' bound to the current row inside expressions.
